items.exampleEn: We had dinner and went for a walk afterward.
items.exampleZh: 我們吃了晚餐，之後去散步。

items.exampleEn: Whoever arrives first should open the office.
items.exampleZh: 誰先到，誰就負責開辦公室的門。

items.exampleEn: All the passengers are now aboard the plane.
items.exampleZh: 所有乘客現在都已登機。

items.exampleEn: It was raining, but we went out anyhow.
items.exampleZh: 雖然在下雨，我們還是出門了。

items.exampleEn: I am not sure whether he will come tomorrow.
items.exampleZh: 我不確定他明天會不會來。

items.exampleEn: Ten people came to the meeting, including the manager.
items.exampleZh: 有十個人來開會，包括經理在內。

items.exampleEn: The tickets cost twenty dollars per person.
Despite the bad weather, the flight left on time.
items.exampleZh: 儘管天氣不好，班機還是準時起飛。

items.exampleEn: The road was closed, and thus we were late.
items.exampleZh: 那條路封閉了，因此我們遲到了。

items.sentenceEn: Whoever finishes the report first can go home early.
items.sentenceZh: 誰先完成報告，誰就可以早點回家。

items.audioEn: Despite the long delay, Lisa stayed calm and waited for the next train.
items.audioZh: 儘管延誤很久，Lisa 仍保持冷靜，等下一班火車。
items.questionZh: Lisa 遇到延誤時怎麼做？
options: She waited for the next train.

items.sentenceEn: We will decide whether to travel after we check the weather.
items.sentenceZh: 我們看過天氣之後再決定要不要去旅行。

items.sentenceEn: The hotel costs one hundred dollars per night, including breakfast.
items.sentenceZh: 這家飯店每晚一百美元，含早餐。

items.stemEn: ____ the heavy rain, the game continued.
items.stemZh: 儘管雨下得很大，比賽仍繼續進行。

items.stemEn: We missed the last bus and ____ had to walk home.
items.stemZh: 我們錯過了最後一班公車，因此只好走路回家。

items.passageEn: Kevin and his team were going to a meeting by boat. Everyone, including the new staff, was aboard by eight o'clock. Despite a strong wind, the trip was calm. Kevin did not know whether there would be time for lunch, so he bought sandwiches for everyone. Afterward, the team thanked him. The sandwiches cost five dollars per person, and Kevin said whoever was still hungry could have another one.
items.passageZh: Kevin 和他的團隊要搭船去開會。八點前，所有人都上船了，包括新進員工。儘管風很大，航程還算平穩。Kevin 不知道會不會有時間吃午餐，所以替大家買了三明治。之後，團隊向他道謝。三明治每人五美元，Kevin 說誰還餓都可以再拿一個。

questions.questionZh: Kevin 為什麼替大家買三明治？
options: 因為不確定有沒有時間吃午餐

items.promptZh: 儘管很累，她還是完成了工作。
referenceEn: Despite being tired, she finished the work.
Despite feeling tired, she finished her work.
rubricZh: despite 後面接名詞或動名詞，不接完整子句
主要子句時態用過去式

items.promptZh: 她剛才問我是否需要幫忙。
referenceEn: She just asked me whether I needed help.
She asked me whether I needed any help just now.
rubricZh: 用 whether 表示「是否」（例如 asked me whether…；寫 if 也正確）
「需要幫忙」可寫，例如 needed help、needed any help 等；時態配合「剛才」（例如 asked、has just asked 等）
